/**
 * @brief 处理 0x1D (CMD_SYSTEM_CONTROL) 受控进入 Bootloader 或软复位指令
 * @param seq 16位序列号
 * @param frame 完整请求帧指针
 * @param plen 载荷长度
 */
static void handle_mc_sys_ctrl(uint16_t seq, const uint8_t *frame, uint16_t plen)
{
    if (plen < sizeof(minimc_sys_ctrl_req_t))
    {
        send_mc_nack(frame, seq, 0x02U);
        return;
    }
    minimc_sys_ctrl_req_t req;
    (void)memcpy(&req, frame + MINIMC_HEADER_SIZE, sizeof(req));
    if ((req.action > 2U) || (req.target_component > 1U))
    {
        send_mc_nack(frame, seq, MINIMC_ERR_COMMAND_REJECTED);
        return;
    }
    const minimc_ack_payload_t ack_pay = { 16U, 8U, 0U };
    if (req.action == 0U)
    {
        (void)send_mc_ack_frame(MINIMC_CMD_ACK, seq, &ack_pay, sizeof(ack_pay));
        return;
    }
    const bool job_busy = (s_dbg_state.job_state_id != 0U) &&
                          (s_dbg_state.job_state_id != 4U) &&
                          (s_dbg_state.job_state_id != 5U);
    if ((movesplanned() > 0U) || job_busy || (s_dbg_state.nozzle_set_ddC > 0) ||
        (s_dbg_state.bed_set_ddC > 0) || s_th_proxy_active || mc_app_is_busy_hook())
    {
        send_mc_nack(frame, seq, MINIMC_ERR_DEVICE_BUSY);
        return;
    }
    Heater_set_target_temperature(&Extruder_One, 0);
    Heater_set_target_temperature(&Platform, 0);
    s_dbg_state.nozzle_set_ddC = 0;
    s_dbg_state.bed_set_ddC = 0;
    quickStop();
    (void)send_mc_ack_frame(MINIMC_CMD_ACK, seq, &ack_pay, sizeof(ack_pay));
    uint32_t tdc_timeout = 100000U;
    while ((usart_flag_get(USART2, USART_TDC_FLAG) == RESET) && (tdc_timeout > 0U))
    {
        tdc_timeout--;
    }
    if (req.action == 2U)
    {
        volatile uint32_t *flag_ptr = mc_get_upgrade_flag_ptr();
        if (flag_ptr != NULL)
        {
            *flag_ptr = MC_BOOT_UPGRADE_MAGIC;
        }
    }
    mc_sys_reset_hook((req.delay_ms > 0U) ? req.delay_ms : 50U);
}

/**
 * @brief 处理 0x1A (LEVEL_TRIGGER) 触发调平控制命令
 * @param seq 16位序列号
 */
static void handle_mc_level_trigger(uint16_t seq)
{
    mc_proto_enqueue_gcode("G29");
    bool has_nonzero = false;
static uint16_t handle_th_sys_ctrl(const uint8_t *frame, uint16_t plen, uint8_t *out_buf)
{
    const uint8_t src_id = frame[2];
    const uint16_t seq = (uint16_t)frame[8] | ((uint16_t)frame[9] << 8U);
    if (plen < (uint16_t)sizeof(minimc_sys_ctrl_req_t))
    {
        return build_nack_resp(src_id, seq, 0x02U, out_buf);
    }
    const uint8_t action = frame[12];
    const uint8_t target_comp = frame[13];
    const uint16_t delay_ms = (uint16_t)frame[14] | ((uint16_t)frame[15] << 8U);
    if ((action > 2U) || (target_comp > 1U))
    {
        return build_nack_resp(src_id, seq, MINIMC_ERR_COMMAND_REJECTED, out_buf);
    }
    if (action == 0U)
    {
        return build_ack_resp(src_id, seq, out_buf);
    }
    if ((load_filament_Flag != 0) || (thermistor_get_target_deci_c() > 0) || th_app_is_busy_hook())
    {
        return build_nack_resp(src_id, seq, MINIMC_ERR_DEVICE_BUSY, out_buf);
    }
    thermistor_set_target_deci_c(0);
    quickStop();
    load_filament_Flag = 0;
    const uint16_t ack_len = build_ack_resp(src_id, seq, out_buf);
    if (ack_len > 0U)
    {
        usart1_send_raw(out_buf, ack_len);
    }
    if (action == 2U)
    {
        volatile uint32_t *flag_ptr = th_get_upgrade_flag_ptr();
        if (flag_ptr != NULL)
        {
            *flag_ptr = TH_BOOT_UPGRADE_MAGIC;
        }
    }
    th_sys_reset_hook((delay_ms > 0U) ? delay_ms : 50U);
    return 0U;
}

/**
 * @brief 解析 0x1C 级联 G-code 关键副作用（M104/M109 设温、T0~T3 选槽、M112 急停）。

  "findings": [
    "阻断：MC 与 TH 的 0x1D 处理只将加热目标设为零并调用 quickStop，没有禁用步进驱动。quickStop 清除运动队列，不等于电机去能；这不满足接受范围中的安全停机/步进禁用要求。证据：MC handle_mc_sys_ctrl 与 TH handle_th_sys_ctrl，以及 TH stepper.c 中 quickStop 的实现。",
    "阻断：TH 头文件仍将 MINIMC_CMD_FILAMENT_CONTROL 定义为 0x15，与 TEMP_REPORT 冲突；Rev 2.0.4 要求该供料控制别名使用 0x19。新增的 MINIMC_CMD_FILAMENT_CTRL_V2 为 0x19 并未修正旧公开宏，因而命令表未完全对齐。",
    "阻断：MC 和 TH 的 0x1D 处理均只拒绝短于 4 字节的载荷（plen < sizeof），对大于 4 字节的载荷仍执行命令；接受协议规定该命令载荷固定为 4 字节。"
